title.en: Your Small-Help Role at a Community Fair
title.zh: 社区小市集：你会怎样搭把手？

description.en: Six fictional fair choices about a short shift, a clearly bounded task and leaving useful information for the next helper. Find your contribution style.
description.zh: 六次虚构市集选择，安排短时段、边界清楚的小任务，也给下一位帮手留有用信息，发现你的贡献方式。

introduction.en: Imagine a small fictional craft fair with optional help invited in advance. You can say what time and effort you actually want to offer. The result concerns a modest group contribution, not civic worth, work performance or an obligation to volunteer.
introduction.zh: 想象提前自愿招呼帮手的小型虚构手作市集。你可以说清实际愿给的时间精力。结果只谈一份适度群体贡献，不评公民价值、工作表现，也不要求志愿服务。

focus.en: Making a voluntary contribution manageable through a time boundary, a task boundary or a clear handover.
focus.zh: 通过时间边界、任务边界或清楚交接，让自愿贡献容易掌握。

prompt.en: The fair asks whether you want to help. You first specify…
prompt.zh: 市集问是否愿帮忙，你先说明……

label.en: A short time window you can genuinely offer.
label.zh: 一个确实愿意提供的短时段。

label.en: One small task you can take to a clear finish.
label.zh: 一件能做到清楚结尾的小任务。

label.en: One way to make information easier for the next helper to use.
label.zh: 一种让下一帮手更易用信息的办法。

prompt.en: A sign table needs attention. You prefer to…
prompt.zh: 标牌桌需要人照应，你更愿……

label.en: Prepare the agreed set of signs and stop when they are ready.
label.zh: 备好已约那组标牌，完成就停。

label.en: Cover the table for the agreed short period.
label.zh: 按已约短时段照看桌子。

label.en: Leave a simple note showing which signs are ready and where they go.
label.zh: 留简单说明，指出哪些已好、该放哪。

prompt.en: The organizer asks for more than originally discussed. You…
prompt.zh: 组织者提出比原来更多的帮助，你会……

label.en: Restate the time you can offer before deciding about anything extra.
label.zh: 先重说可用时段，再决定额外内容。

label.en: Separate the original task from the proposed addition.
label.zh: 分清原任务与新增部分。

label.en: Clarify what needs passing on if you cannot extend your help.
label.zh: 若不能延长，问清需交接什么。

prompt.zh: 另一位帮手中途到达，你会……

label.en: Show the current state and the one next action they need.
label.zh: 说明当前状态与所需下一动作。

label.en: Agree on when your part ends and theirs begins.
label.zh: 约好自己何时结束、对方何时开始。

label.en: Divide one concrete task so each part has a clear owner.
label.zh: 拆一件具体任务，让各部分归属清楚。

prompt.en: Your agreed contribution is nearly complete. You…

label.en: Finish the defined piece without automatically taking another.
label.zh: 完成已定义那件，不自动接下一件。

label.en: Give a short notice that your time window is ending.
label.zh: 简短提醒自己的时段将结束。

label.en: Check that the remaining information is easy to find.
label.zh: 看看剩余信息是否容易找到。

prompt.en: What would make helping feel worthwhile and sustainable?
prompt.zh: 怎样会让帮忙值得，也容易持续？

label.en: I could leave a clear state for whoever continues.
label.zh: 能给接着做的人留清楚状态。

label.en: The contribution fitted the time I actually wanted to give.
label.zh: 贡献适合自己实际愿给的时间。

label.en: One useful thing reached a recognizable finish.
label.zh: 一件有用小事到达可辨认结尾。

summary.en: Your contribution has a beginning and an end that other people can understand. A modest time window is still a real offer. The portrait values an honest commitment rather than suggesting that longer volunteering always means greater care.
summary.zh: 你的贡献有别人能理解的开始和结束。适度时段仍是真实提供。画像珍惜诚实承诺，不暗示帮越久就越关心。

example.en: You might offer half an hour at an illustrated sign-in table and tell the organizer when you need the next person to take over.
example.zh: 在插画签到桌，你可能提供半小时，也告诉组织者何时需要下一人接替。

strength.en: A clear time boundary can make planning easier for everyone and reduce the uncertainty of an offer that sounds unlimited but cannot be.
strength.zh: 清楚时间边界能让大家容易安排，也减少听似无限、实际不可能无限的提供。

tradeoff.en: A time window still needs a workable handover when others depend on the task. A little advance notice helps the boundary function in practice.
tradeoff.zh: 他人依赖任务时，时段也需要可用交接。提前一点提醒，让边界实际起作用。

experiment.en: For one voluntary group contribution, name the time you can actually offer and how you will signal the end. Keep extending it genuinely optional.
experiment.zh: 一次自愿群体贡献里，说明实际能给多久、怎样提示结束。让延长真正保持可选。

summary.en: Your fair contribution is defined by one small useful thing reaching its finish. You can see what is included and what is a separate request. The result values a bounded task rather than measuring productivity or generosity.
summary.zh: 你的市集贡献由一件有用小事到达结尾定义。你看得见包含什么、哪些是另一次请求。结果珍惜有边界任务，不测效率或慷慨。

example.en: You might agree to letter five display cards, confirm their wording with the organizer and hand over that finished set without taking on all the other signs.
example.zh: 你可能同意写五张展示卡，确认文字，再交好这组，不包下其他所有牌子。

strength.en: A concrete task boundary can make an offer easier to understand and prevent a small contribution from silently becoming an open-ended role.
strength.zh: 具体任务边界让提供易懂，也避免小贡献悄悄长成无止境角色。

tradeoff.en: A defined task may still take longer than expected. Checking both its scope and the available time keeps the offer realistic.
tradeoff.zh: 已定义任务也可能比预想久。范围与可用时间一起确认，提供才实际。

experiment.en: Choose one small useful group task and state what counts as finished. Ask before adding anything beyond that definition.
experiment.zh: 选一件有用群体小任务，说明什么算完成。超出定义前，再询问是否要添。

summary.en: Your help includes leaving the next person enough context to continue. A brief state note can matter as much as another finished item. The portrait values a useful handover without requiring a full record of everything that happened.
summary.zh: 你的帮助包含给下一人足够情境接续。简短状态说明，也许与再完成一件同样重要。画像珍惜可用交接，不要求全量记录所有经过。

example.en: You might leave a note saying which display cards are done, where the spare materials sit and which single question still needs the organizer’s answer.
example.zh: 你可能留一笔：哪些展示卡已好、备用材料在哪、哪一个问题仍等组织者答。

strength.en: A compact handover can reduce repeated questions and let the next helper start without reconstructing the whole earlier shift.
strength.zh: 紧凑交接能减少重复问题，让下一帮手不必重建前一班全部经过就能开始。

tradeoff.en: An exhaustive handover can be harder to use than a short one. The next person usually needs the current state and the relevant next step first.
tradeoff.zh: 穷尽交接可能比短交接难用。下一人通常先需要当前状态与相关下一步。

experiment.en: At one small shared handover, write three plain items: what is done, what is next and who can answer the remaining question.
experiment.zh: 一次小共同交接，写三项普通说明：已做什么、接着什么、剩余问题可问谁。

topic.zh: 社区小市集帮忙角色测试

title.zh: 社区小市集帮忙角色测试

description.en: Choose a manageable way to help at a fictional fair: a time slot, a defined task or a clear handover. Six choices create three volunteer-contribution portraits.
description.zh: 在虚构小市集中，选一段时长、一件明确任务或一次清楚交接。六次选择，看看你怎样让自愿帮忙可承担。

question.en: What makes a contribution manageable in this quiz?
question.zh: 本测试里，什么让一份帮忙变得可承担？

answer.en: A time slot limits when you help, a task boundary limits what you take on, and a handover clarifies what happens next. None requires taking responsibility for the whole fair or always being available.
answer.zh: 时间段限制何时帮忙，任务边界限制接什么，交接说明接下来怎样。都不要求承担整个市集，也不要求一直有空。
